name: dde_links
expr: [(n, doc.DDELinks.getByName(n).Application, doc.DDELinks.getByName(n).Topic, doc.DDELinks.getByName(n).Item) for n in doc.DDELinks.ElementNames]

name: dde_cells
expr: [(r,c,doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0).getCellByPosition(c,r).Formula) for r in range(8) for c in range(4) if doc.Sheets.getByIndex(0).getCellByPosition(c,r).Formula.startswith('=DDE')]
